## Marks reach the code block

`mark=` on a step of `.explain-code-manim` is collected into `mark-steps`, the
same as in `.explain-code` — and so it also reaches code-mark's build-time check.

::: {.explain-code-manim}
```{.python .manim}
from manim import *


class DefaultTemplate(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.next_section("tree")
        self.next_section("deep")
```

```{.go}
func minimax(b *Board, depth int) int {
	return best(b, depth-1)
}
```
